name: explore-plan-oracle
description: Read-only contract-first chain: explore the requested scope, plan the smallest implementation slice, then oracle-review the plan.

steps.task: Explore the repository context for goal: {goal}. Identify relevant files, current behavior, gaps, and evidence only; do not edit or run write-capable commands.
mustDo: Cite exact files and observed evidence
Identify gaps and next bounded step
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}

steps.task: Plan the smallest safe implementation slice for goal: {goal}, using prior chain evidence from steps: {previous_step_ids}. Produce a TDD/verification sequence and stop conditions only.
steps.expectedOutcome: Bounded implementation plan with validation ladder and risks
mustDo: Consume prior exploration evidence before re-reading
Name exact files likely to change and validation commands
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}

steps.task: Review the chain plan for goal: {goal}. Verify whether the proposed scope, safety constraints, evidence, and validation are sufficient. Return PASS/FAIL/WARN without editing.
steps.expectedOutcome: Oracle verdict on whether the read-only plan is sufficient to implement safely
mustDo: Flag missing validation or unsafe scope
